scene.label: Act 2, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. Tyre. A room in the Governor's house.
scene.location: Tyre. A room in the Governor's house.

lines.text: No, Escanes, know this of me,
lines.plainText: No Escanes know this of me

lines.text: Antiochus from incest lived not free:
lines.plainText: Antiochus from incest lived not free

lines.text: For which the most high gods not minding longer
lines.plainText: For which the most high gods not minding longer

lines.text: To withhold the vengeance that they had in store
lines.plainText: To withhold the vengeance that they had in store

lines.text: Due to this heinous capital offence,
lines.plainText: Due to this heinous capital offence

lines.text: Even in the height and pride of all his glory,
lines.plainText: Even in the height and pride of all his glory

lines.text: When he was seated in a chariot
lines.plainText: When he was seated in a chariot

lines.text: Of an inestimable value, and his daughter with him,
lines.plainText: Of an inestimable value and his daughter with him

lines.text: A fire from heaven came and shrivell'd up
lines.plainText: A fire from heaven came and shrivell'd up

lines.text: Their bodies, even to loathing, for they so stunk,
lines.plainText: Their bodies even to loathing for they so stunk

lines.text: That all those eyes adored them ere their fall
lines.plainText: That all those eyes adored them ere their fall

lines.text: Scorn now their hand should give them burial.
lines.plainText: Scorn now their hand should give them burial

lines.text: 'Twas very strange
lines.plainText: 'Twas very strange

lines.text: And yet but justice; for though this king were great;
lines.plainText: And yet but justice for though this king were great

lines.text: His greatness was no guard to bar heaven's shaft,
lines.plainText: His greatness was no guard to bar heaven's shaft

lines.text: But sin had his reward.
lines.plainText: But sin had his reward

lines.text: 'Tis very true.
lines.plainText: 'Tis very true

lines.text: See, not a man in private conference
lines.plainText: See not a man in private conference

lines.text: Or council has respect with him but he.
lines.plainText: Or council has respect with him but he

lines.text: It shall no longer grieve without reproof.
lines.plainText: It shall no longer grieve without reproof

lines.text: And cursed be he that will not second it.
lines.plainText: And cursed be he that will not second it

lines.text: Follow me, then. Lord Helicane, a word.
lines.plainText: Follow me then Lord Helicane a word

lines.text: With me? and welcome: happy day, my lords.
lines.plainText: With me and welcome happy day my lords

lines.text: Know that our griefs are risen to the top,
lines.plainText: Know that our griefs are risen to the top

lines.text: And now at length they overflow their banks.
lines.plainText: And now at length they overflow their banks

lines.text: Your griefs! for what? Wrong not your prince you love.
lines.plainText: Your griefs for what Wrong not your prince you love

lines.text: Wrong not yourself, then, noble Helicane;
lines.plainText: Wrong not yourself then noble Helicane

lines.text: But if the prince do live, let us salute him.
lines.plainText: But if the prince do live let us salute him

lines.text: Or know what ground's made happy by his breath.
lines.plainText: Or know what ground's made happy by his breath

lines.text: If in the world he live, we'll seek him out;
lines.plainText: If in the world he live we'll seek him out

lines.text: If in his grave he rest, we'll find him there.
lines.plainText: If in his grave he rest we'll find him there

lines.text: We'll be resolved he lives to govern us,
lines.plainText: We'll be resolved he lives to govern us

lines.text: Or dead, give's cause to mourn his funeral,
lines.plainText: Or dead give's cause to mourn his funeral

lines.text: And leave us to our free election.
lines.plainText: And leave us to our free election

lines.text: Whose death's indeed the strongest in our censure:
lines.plainText: Whose death's indeed the strongest in our censure

lines.text: And knowing this kingdom is without a head,—
lines.plainText: And knowing this kingdom is without a head

lines.text: Like goodly buildings left without a roof
lines.plainText: Like goodly buildings left without a roof

lines.text: Soon fall to ruin,—your noble self,
lines.plainText: Soon fall to ruinyour noble self

lines.text: That best know how to rule and how to reign,
lines.plainText: That best know how to rule and how to reign

lines.text: We thus submit unto,—our sovereign.
lines.plainText: We thus submit untoour sovereign

lines.text: Live, noble Helicane!
lines.plainText: Live noble Helicane

lines.text: For honour's cause, forbear your suffrages:
lines.plainText: For honour's cause forbear your suffrages

lines.text: If that you love Prince Pericles, forbear.
lines.plainText: If that you love Prince Pericles forbear

lines.text: Take I your wish, I leap into the seas,
lines.plainText: Take I your wish I leap into the seas

lines.text: Where's hourly trouble for a minute's ease.
lines.plainText: Where's hourly trouble for a minute's ease

lines.text: A twelvemonth longer, let me entreat you
lines.plainText: A twelvemonth longer let me entreat you

lines.text: To forbear the absence of your king;
lines.plainText: To forbear the absence of your king

lines.text: If in which time expired, he not return,
lines.plainText: If in which time expired he not return

lines.text: I shall with aged patience bear your yoke.
lines.plainText: I shall with aged patience bear your yoke

lines.text: But if I cannot win you to this love,
lines.plainText: But if I cannot win you to this love

lines.text: Go search like nobles, like noble subjects,
lines.plainText: Go search like nobles like noble subjects

lines.text: And in your search spend your adventurous worth;
lines.plainText: And in your search spend your adventurous worth

lines.text: Whom if you find, and win unto return,
lines.plainText: Whom if you find and win unto return

lines.text: You shall like diamonds sit about his crown.
lines.plainText: You shall like diamonds sit about his crown

lines.text: To wisdom he's a fool that will not yield;
lines.plainText: To wisdom he's a fool that will not yield

lines.text: And since Lord Helicane enjoineth us,
lines.plainText: And since Lord Helicane enjoineth us

lines.text: We with our travels will endeavour us.
lines.plainText: We with our travels will endeavour us

lines.text: Then you love us, we you, and we'll clasp hands:
lines.plainText: Then you love us we you and we'll clasp hands

lines.text: When peers thus knit, a kingdom ever stands.
lines.plainText: When peers thus knit a kingdom ever stands
